headline: Berkshire Hathaway shares hit eight-month high
summary: The conglomerate that Warren Buffett built rallied to an eight-month high this week. There could be more gains ahead if they play catch up with the S&P 500.

headline: Bank Of America (BAC) Buys MDSec In First Deal For Five Years
summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) has agreed to acquire UK based cybersecurity firm MDSec Consulting. The deal is aimed at strengthening the bank's digital defense capabilities in response to rising AI driven cyber threats. This is Bank of America's first acquisition in five years and is expected to support its growth plans in the UK and globally.
